text: so i made a door that has a glass window in it, and i have some other walls that have glass windows in them, they all use to load properly, but the doors are rendering as a solid and the walls with the windows are rendering just as hollow. but, glass still works. i know because of this prop i have that is a glass framed image [Image #14] but look, this wall with window looks just hollow of glass [Image #15] and then this door has no glass at all [Image #16] but here it is in the editor [Image #17]
resolution: Diagnosed and fixed cooked-prop glass in the no-V8 /compiled game (the editor looked fine, masking it). Decoded the actual baked gamefile to ground-truth: window WALLS already ship a translucent glass slot (material ref 19, opacity 0.34) but world_loader fell back to the prop's gray tint #c2c6cf, so 34% gray over bright sky read as a hollow opening — fixed by tinting flat-translucent mesh-prop slots the editor's Glass() blue (new materials.ts GLASS_TINT #a9c8d8, hand-mirrored into world_loader.zig). DOORS shipped ZERO glass refs because a window on the swinging Door Leaf was baked into the opaque leaf (the cook's glass pass only scanned body parts) — fixed by laying the leaf out opaque-frame-then-glass-pane (cookedAsset.flattenModel new leafGlass range), splitting it into opaque+translucent slots in worldGeometry, and binding the whole leaf slot RANGE to the door so stepCookedDoors swings frame and window together (CookedDoor.node_child_first/_count). Walls fix is loader-only (rebuild+rebake). Door fix needs the user to RE-COOK the door model in Studio then re-compile (the split is cook-time). Tests: cookedAsset 23/23 incl. new leaf-glass + glassless-leaf regression; worldGeometry/worldParity green; no-V8 loader builds+renders.
